description: Workflow for compacting the current conversation into a handoff document that another Claude Code session can pick up from later. Produces a single Markdown file capturing the goal, current state, in-flight work, decisions made, open questions, paths touched, and a recommended next-session skill — referencing existing artifacts (commits, PRs, diffs, plan docs, tickets, ADRs) by path or URL rather than duplicating them. NOT for writing tickets for a human development team (use /write-ticket for that) and NOT for permanent documentation of decisions (commits, ADRs, or the codebase own that).
